text:
Leah (PM): starting rollout planning for 'response-streaming v1' — objective: NA opt-in beta, then EU full roll. want safe canary + A/B compare.
Ravi (Eng): plan: flag + shadowing. Stage1: shadow 20% EU for 48h, collect quality deltas. Stage2: visible 5% NA opt-in -> 25% -> 100.
Jules (SRE): canary infra: dedicate 2 g4dn nodes in eu-west, warm caches. alarms: 5xx>0.4% OR p99>400ms for 10m -> rollback. include per-tenant kill switch.
Marta (Data): metrics to track: per-tenant latency (p50/p95/p99), token-cost delta, eval-quality A/B (BLEU-like and human-labeled subset). will prepare sample set.
Leah (PM): launch gates: smoke at 5% (no infra alarms, quality delta <=1.0%), conditional approval at 25%. require runbook + customer comms for enterprise tenants.
Ravi (Eng): flag JSON proto for ops:
```json
{"flag":"response_stream_v1","variants":[{"name":"baseline","ratio":0.95},{"name":"stream_v1","ratio":0.05}],"regions":["NA","EU"],"opt_in":"tenant_level","kill_switch":"global_off"}
```
Jules (SRE): add fallback options: route to quantized model or baseline model depending on health check. will add sliding qps cap and safety throttle.
deploy-bot: scheduled shadow-start: 2026-06-10T02:00Z, visible-start: 2026-06-14T15:00Z
Marta (Data): need ~8k requests per arm for ~1% detectable lift. dashboard PR incoming today.
Leah (PM): action items: Ravi - implement shadow routing + flag schema; Jules - alarms + per-tenant killpath; Marta - dashboards + eval set; Leah - comms + runbook. target soft launch: 2026-06-14.
Ravi (Eng): no blockers from eng.
Jules (SRE): will block change if infra unstable during canary window.
Leah (PM): great. I'll drop the runbook in #launchroom once green.
